tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Compactness of geodesic segments in a compact set] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0319, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0320 1. Lemma B.45\group comparison-theorems

In a complete manifold, the family of geodesic segments with endpoints constrained to a compact set admits convergent subsequences after passing to a subsequence of initial data.
